description: Use this to answer: "Is <game> on Game Pass?", "When does <game> leave Game Pass?", "Can I play <game> with a subscription?". Lists which subscriptions (currently PC Game Pass and Game Pass Ultimate) include the game in a region, their monthly price and the leave date when announced.

game_id.description: Steam AppID (e.g. 730) or IGDB id (e.g. igdb:1942).

region.description: Region: tr, us, eu or gb. Default: detected from the caller's IP, us when unknown.

name: is_on_subscription
